title: Hot Water
synopsis: Have you ever been served hot water in China, even though it’s the middle of summer? Here we take a look at why the Chinese love drinking hot water.

fullText.simplified:
为什么中国人爱喝热水

    不知道你有没有过这样的经历，即使在夏天，中国餐馆里的茶水也是热的。不知道你有没有过这样的疑问，中国人怎么都爱喝热水？
    为什么中国人爱喝热水，即使是中国人也不太清楚原因，大家说法不一。
    有人说，是因为中国的自来水质量不好，不能像外国一样直接喝，需要烧开了才能喝。
    也有人说，是因为喝热水健康。喝生水，也就是自来水，会有很多细菌。喝凉水，也就是开水自然变凉的水，会对胃不好，容易造成胃疼或者拉肚子等。
    在我看来，喝热水是一种习惯。我们从小就被教育，不能喝生水，要喝热水。而当胃从小习惯热水后，喝凉水自然不舒服。
    中国人为什么“爱”喝热水，既然用了“爱”，也就是说这种行为更多的是出自情感与体验，而没有什么科学道理。有时候我们做一些事情的时候是很少思考的，并不是我们拒绝那么做，而是习惯了这么做。要真要下个结论，也许是——“果然，还是自己舒服最重要”吧。
fullText.traditional:
為什麼中國人愛喝熱水

    不知道你有沒有過這樣的經歷，即使在夏天，中國餐館裡的茶水也是熱的。不知道你有沒有過這樣的疑問，中國人怎麼都愛喝熱水？
    為什麼中國人愛喝熱水，即使是中國人也不太清楚原因，大家說法不一。
    有人說，是因為中國的自來水質量不好，不能像外國一樣直接喝，需要燒開了才能喝。
    也有人說，是因為喝熱水健康。喝生水，也就是自來水，會有很多細菌。喝涼水，也就是開水自然變涼的水，會對胃不好，容易造成胃疼或者拉肚子等。
    在我看來，喝熱水是一種習慣。我們從小就被教育，不能喝生水，要喝熱水。而當胃從小習慣熱水後，喝涼水自然不舒服。
    中國人為什麼“愛”喝熱水，既然用了“愛”，也就是說這種行為更多的是出自情感與體驗，而沒有什麼科學道理。有時候我們做一些事情的時候是很少思考的，並不是我們拒絕那麼做，而是習慣了這麼做。要真要下個結論，也許是——“果然，還是自己舒服最重要”吧。

raw.synopsis: Have you ever been served hot water in China, even though it’s the middle of summer? Here we take a look at why the Chinese love drinking hot water.
sentence_translations: Why do Chinese people love drinking hot water
I don't know if you've had this experience: even though it's summer, the tea in the Chinese restaraunt is still hot.
I don't know if you've questioned yourself: why do Chinese people all love drinking hot water?
The reason Chinese people love drinking hot water is not clear even to the Chinese themselves, with everyone having a different opinion.
Some people say it's because China's tap water quality is not good; you can't drink it directly like abroad, but must boil it before you drink.
Other people say it is because drinking hot water is healthy.
Drinking unboiled water, in other words tap water, can have a lot of germs.
Drinking cold water, that is boiled water which has cooled down naturally, can be bad for your stomach, and can easily cause stomach ache or diarrhea.
In my opinion, drinking hot water is a type of custom.
From childhood we have been taught not to drink tap water, and that we must drink hot water.
And once the stomach gets used to drinking hot water, drinking cold water naturally feels uncomfortable.
Why do Chinese people "love" drinking hot water?
Since we use the word "love", it indicates that this behavior mostly comes from emotions and experience, and does not have a scientific explanation.
Sometimes when we do something, we do it without much consideration.
And it's not that we reject other ways of doing things, but that we're used to our way of doing things.
If we really must come to a conclusion, then maybe it is -- "in the end, what's most important is whether you feel comfortable".
